data.one_liner: Parses total and available disk spaces on Windows and UNIX-based systems
data.what_it_does: Parses total and available disk spaces on Windows and UNIX-based systems, including Linux and macOS. It allows scanning for disks, retrieving their mount paths, device paths, and space metrics, and querying specific directories.
use_when: You need to check available or total disk space on desktop or mobile systems
You want to find which disk a specific directory or FileSystemEntity belongs to
avoid_when: You need general key-value or local database storage rather than disk space statistics
strengths: Supports both Windows and UNIX-based systems like Linux and macOS
Easy-to-use API for scanning and inspecting storage devices
weaknesses: Platform parsing relies on system commands which may behave differently across environments
macOS support was historically noted as untested
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import universal_disk_space.
